description: A specialized TEAM and SKILL pack for the farming and homestead career: trade how-to entries for building, repairing, and improvising farm infrastructure, plus career-skill entries that refine the craft (seasonal planning, soil and livestock observation discipline, making the place pay) and team-play entries for how farm crews and families coordinate through seasons, improvise together under pressure, train each other, and divide work fairly. Team guidance + skill development aimed at refining and improving the career, building toward personal refinement tools.

entry_kinds.career_skill: Entries on the improve/combine tracks: refining the craft, leveling up the operation, seasonal planning, observation discipline, making the place pay.
entry_kinds.team_play: Entries on coordinating farm crews/families: seasonal rhythm, storm and breakdown improvisation, training, fair work division. mechanism_check = the coordination challenge; improvised_tools = roles, rituals, lightweight processes; steps = the play; stop_conditions = when the play fails / escalate.
entry_kinds.trade: Sidewinder-structured how-to entries (mechanism -> improvise -> steps -> stop), lawful DIY only.

name: Farming & Homestead
notes_for_editions_framework: DRAFT — for validation by the main Sidewinder builder's editions framework.
All entries use domain 'outdoor' per the current valid-domains list; if team/skill entries later merit their own domain, the framework should advise.

Prerequisites reference only ids within this pack (homestead-034 -> homestead-031, homestead-026 -> homestead-011, homestead-027 -> homestead-003, homestead-040 -> homestead-038, homestead-043 -> homestead-035).
